text: WOULD YOU PRAY WITH ME? GOD, OUR PROVIDER, ALL THAT WE NEED. YOU SUPPLY THE STRENGTH THAT WE REQUIRE FOR THE DAYS AHEAD. YOU MAKE AVAILABLE TO US.
